program:
app "Rent" home slate
table tenant name text, phone text?
table rent_entry tenant ref tenant, amount money, kind pick Due|Paid, note text?
"Rent owed" sum(rent_entry.amount where kind = Due) - sum(rent_entry.amount where kind = Paid) big
each tenant as p
  let bal = sum(p.rent_entry.amount where kind = Due) - sum(p.rent_entry.amount where kind = Paid)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "paid ahead") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
    "Last entry" last(p.rent_entry.at) faint
form tenant, "Add tenant"
form rent_entry, "Add entry"
list rent_entry by day
describe:
Rent, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- tenant: name: text; phone: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- rent entry: tenant: a tenant; amount: money; kind: one of Due, Paid; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Rent owed", the total amount of rent entry where kind is Due minus the total amount of rent entry where kind is Paid.
- for each tenant:
  - a group; a tap opens the tenant for editing:
    - text: the name of the tenant.
    - text: "owes you" when bal is at least 0, otherwise "paid ahead", bal without its sign.
    - text: "Last entry", the latest at of the tenant's rent entry entries.
- a form to add a tenant.
- a form to add a rent entry.
- a list of rent entry by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Study timer" timer ink
table session subject text, mins num 0..
state sub text = ""
state el dur = 0s
state going bool = no
every 1s if going set el = el + 1s
field sub "Subject"
el big
row gap 1
  button if(going, "Pause", "Start") tap set going = not going
  button "Save" tap add session subject = sub, mins = round(el / 1m) then set going = no then set el = 0s
"Minutes per subject" head
each session by subject
  row
    it.key grow
    sum(it.mins) "min" bold
daybars last 7 days, sum(session.mins on it)
list session by day
describe:
Study timer, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- session: subject: text; mins: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: sub, starting at ""; el, starting at 0 hours; going, starting at no.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while going, it sets el to el plus 1 seconds.
- a box to fill in sub, labelled "Subject".
- text: el.
- a button "Pause" when going, otherwise "Start"; a tap sets going to not going.
- a button "Save"; a tap adds a session with subject set to sub, mins set to el divided by 1 minute rounded, then sets going to no, then sets el to 0 hours.
- text: "Minutes per subject".
- for each group of session entries by subject:
  - text: its key.
  - text: the total mins of the group, "min".
- a bar chart of the total mins of session on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of session by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
